Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	xberg "github.com/xberg-io/xberg/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	input := xberg.ExtractInput{
		Kind:     ptr(xberg.ExtractInputKindBytes),
		Bytes:    []byte{90, 97, 114, 110, 97, 107},
		MimeType: ptr(`text/plain`),
		Filename: ptr(`external-findings-invalid.txt`),
	}
	config := xberg.ExtractionConfig{}
	var findings []xberg.ExternalRedactionFinding
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[{"label":"inspection_person","score":0.99,"text":"zarnak"}]`), &findings); err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("config parse failed: %v", err))
	}
	offset_encodingVal := `bytes-ish`
	_, err := xberg.ExtractWithExternalRedaction(input, config, findings, &offset_encodingVal, 8)
	var typedError xberg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
